p07.label: Woman in a Café with Barista in the Background
p07.text:
A stylish young woman seated alone in a cozy neighborhood café near a large
window on a rainy afternoon. She is the clearly defined main subject, framed
from the waist up while holding a ceramic coffee cup with both hands and
looking thoughtfully toward the street. She wears a soft beige coat over a
dark top, with natural makeup and loose shoulder-length hair. In the
background, a barista works behind the counter preparing drinks beside an
espresso machine. Wooden tables, hanging lamps, pastries in a glass display,
subtle steam, reflections on the window and blurred city traffic outside
create a rich everyday setting. Grounded live-action lifestyle photography,
realistic anatomy, natural skin texture, believable indoor lighting, subtle
depth of field, warm and inviting atmosphere.

p08.label: Man Choosing Between Two Vegetables in a Supermarket
p08.text:
An ordinary man standing in the produce aisle of a modern supermarket,
hesitating between two vegetables while shopping for dinner. He is the main
subject, shown from the knees upward, holding a red bell pepper in his left
hand and a green zucchini in his right hand while comparing them carefully.
He wears a dark casual jacket, jeans and practical sneakers, with a handheld
shopping basket resting beside him. Fresh produce shelves, price labels,
stacked vegetables, soft overhead supermarket lights and a few distant
shoppers create a believable grocery-store scene. Grounded live-action
photography, realistic proportions, natural skin and fabric texture, clear
object readability, balanced composition and an authentic everyday atmosphere.

p09.label: Young Woman on a Commuter Train
p09.text:
A young professional woman riding alone on a modern commuter train in the
late afternoon. She is the clear main subject, seated beside the window and
framed from the thighs upward, holding a smartphone in one hand while the
other rests naturally on a canvas tote bag on her lap. She wears a navy coat,
a light blouse and simple workwear trousers. Outside the window, a soft blur
of city buildings and tracks suggests motion. In the background, a few other
passengers sit farther down the carriage, and metal poles, overhead handles,
seat textures and cool daylight reflections define the interior. Grounded
live-action urban realism, natural posture, believable facial features,
clean modern design, subtle reflections, soft ambient light and a calm daily
commute mood.

p10.label: Man Folding Clothes in a Laundromat
p10.text:
A middle-aged man standing inside a clean neighborhood laundromat while
folding fresh laundry on a waist-high counter. He is the clearly dominant main
subject, shown from the knees upward, with both hands arranging a neatly
folded blue shirt. He wears a plain gray hoodie, dark trousers and casual
shoes. Rows of stainless-steel washing machines and dryers line the walls,
with round doors, detergent bottles, fluorescent ceiling lights and a few
laundry baskets visible around the room. The background remains readable and
organized, creating a familiar everyday environment. Grounded live-action
photography, realistic anatomy, natural hand placement, believable fabric
texture, subtle metallic reflections and a calm slice-of-life atmosphere.

p11.label: Florist Arranging a Bouquet
p11.text:
A young florist standing inside a small flower shop while arranging a fresh
bouquet on a wooden worktable. She is the clear main subject, framed from the
waist upward, holding the bouquet with both hands while adjusting the stems
carefully. She wears a green apron over a cream blouse, with tied-back hair
and a focused expression. Buckets of flowers, wrapping paper, scissors,
ribbons, potted plants and a softly lit shop interior fill the scene. In the
far background, a customer stands near the entrance, adding depth without
competing with the florist. Grounded live-action lifestyle photography,
natural skin and hand detail, believable plant textures, gentle daylight and
a refined contemporary atmosphere.

p12.label: Architect in a Design Studio
p12.text:
A young architect working in a bright contemporary design studio during the
morning. He is the clearly defined main subject, shown from the waist upward
while standing at a large desk and reviewing an architectural model with one
hand, with the other hand resting beside a rolled blueprint. He wears a dark
overshirt over a white T-shirt, with neat short hair and a focused
expression. In the background, a colleague pins drawings to a presentation
board, while shelves, sample materials, sketchbooks, cutting tools, a desk
lamp and large windows complete the workspace. Grounded live-action editorial
photography, realistic anatomy, detailed hands, believable paper and model
textures, balanced modern composition and clean natural daylight.
